featured_reviews.name: Snigdha Bar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently opted for the  Health Package at this diagnostic centre, and I am extremely satisfied with the overall experience. The package was comprehensive and offered excellent value for money, covering a wide range of investigations including blood tests, sonography, 2D Echo, ECG, Stress Test , PFT, and consultations with multiple specialist doctors.
From the moment I arrived, the staff was welcoming, professional, and highly organized. The registration process was smooth, and the team guided me through each test efficiently. Despite the number of investigations included in the package, everything was coordinated very well, minimizing waiting time and ensuring a comfortable experience.
One aspect that particularly stood out was the cleanliness and hygiene of the facility. The centre is well-maintained, with clean waiting areas, consultation rooms, and diagnostic equipment. The staff followed proper hygiene protocols, which made me feel confident and comfortable throughout the visit.
The technicians conducting the sonography, ECG, 2D Echo, PFT, and Stress Test were knowledgeable, patient, and explained the procedures clearly. The blood sample collection was quick and painless, reflecting the expertise of the phlebotomy team.
The consultations with multiple doctors were a major highlight of the package. Each doctor took the time to review my reports carefully, explain the findings in detail, and provide practical health advice. Rather than feeling rushed, I felt that my concerns were genuinely heard and addressed.
The reports were accurate, detailed, and delivered promptly. Considering the number of tests and specialist consultations included, the package was very reasonably priced and represented outstanding value compared to arranging these services individually.
Overall, I highly recommend this diagnostic centre to anyone looking for a thorough preventive health check-up. Their combination of professional staff Dipali and Akansha, excellent diagnostic services, experienced doctors, modern equipment, sara managed the drs so that it could be done on same day very helpful affordable pricing, and exceptional cleanliness makes them a top choice for comprehensive healthcare screening. Thank you to the entire team for providing such a seamless and reassuring experience

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Yelkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Very Disappointing Experience – Not Recommended for Delivery Cases

I had trusted Shatabdi Hospital for years — my father-in-law and mother were admitted here before, and we always believed it was a reliable municipal hospital. But this time, when I went for my pregnancy check-up in my 9th month, my experience was extremely upsetting.

The OPD doctors lack basic respect and communication skills. Instead of guiding patients with care, they speak very rudely, as if they just want to finish their duty. The way they talk to pregnant women is unacceptable.

Despite being a municipal hospital where people seek help with hope, I was treated without dignity. They created unnecessary chaos during my check-up and used language that no patient should have to hear.

To avoid admitting me, they simply checked my blood pressure and weight and declared me a “high risk” patient. I was advised to go to Cooper Hospital or Nair Hospital — their exact words were that Shatabdi Hospital:

➡️ Doesn’t have an OT bed that can take a patient weighing 90 kg or above
➡️ Doesn’t have an anaesthetist capable of handling such patients

This is shocking — how can such a well-known BMC hospital openly say they don’t have facilities for patients over a certain weight? Does that mean only slim patients under 70 kg deserve treatment here?

I strongly feel the doctors here, many of whom seem like interns, carry their frustration and take it out on patients, which is highly unprofessional.

💔 Very bad experience. I will never suggest Shatabdi Hospital for maternity or delivery cases. If you value respect and proper treatment, please reconsider before going here
